# Pixel owner and operator FAQ

## Is a green test suite proof that Pixel is live?

No. Tests prove their asserted fixtures. Repository status, installed-host verification, a real configured-model turn, live tool/provider behavior, recovery rehearsal, and owner acceptance are separate evidence planes.

## Does “Prepared” mean a feature is active?

No. Prepared means coherent configuration or an inert candidate exists but an external setup, reviewed plan, activation, or fresh runtime proof remains.

## Can I expose `./pixel ui` through a tunnel or LAN bind?

No. Use the exact loopback process-lifetime URL. The documented authenticated portal adapter is a separate, status-labeled boundary; do not point a tunnel directly at the local UI.

## Can Pixel accept credentials in the browser?

No. API keys, OAuth material, SSH identities, provider sessions, backup keys, activation, restore, approval, and incident recovery stay in their trusted terminal or issuer paths.

## Why is an enabled limb still unavailable?

Configuration enablement does not prove credentials, service health, endpoint reachability, authority, or live qualification. Run `./pixel limbs`, `./pixel verify`, and the owning limb's acceptance procedure.

## Why did Pixel refuse to retry an action?

The earlier external outcome may be uncertain. Reconcile the existing action journal, claim, result, protected snapshot, and provider state. Deleting the evidence or sending a duplicate can repeat a real effect.

## Does `./pixel verify` test answer quality?

No. It verifies the installed deployment contract and model identity binding. Use the [first real conversation](../use/first-conversation.md) and an operator quality assessment separately.

## Is an encrypted backup ready to restore?

Not until its checksum, signature, trusted signer, decryption, structure, and allowlisted destinations validate and an isolated rehearsal succeeds.

## Can rollback restore every private datum and remote side effect?

No. Deployment rollback restores the saved release/generated configuration transaction. Broker state, remote targets/effects, provider credentials/policies, and workspace/database content have separate custody and recovery rules.

## Can I edit an installed release or broker file to fix drift?

No. Installed releases are immutable and enabled broker bytes must match them. Build/review a plan and use transactional apply or rollback.

## How do I ask for help safely?

Use the [safe support packet](support-bundle.md) and the repository's [support boundary](../../SUPPORT.md). Never attach private state or a recovery archive.
